mentions.name: Native Win32 Steam Frontend
mentions.description: This app is a native Win32 frontend for the Steam client, built with Claude's help as a lightweight alternative to the latest Steam client, which is a Chromium Embedded Framework that runs at all times. It is (dubiously) portable and will be used to run the author's flight simulator.
mentions.problem: The latest Steam client is a Chromium Embedded Framework that runs at all times, which the author found dismayed for gaming use.
mentions.audience: Personal use — the author returning to flight simulation
mentions.source_excerpt: so I used Claude to yak shave my way to a native Win32 frontend (and when I'm done tinkering with it, my Flight Sim). It's also (dubiously) portable.
mentions.author: GaryBluto
